title: Loss-History Share of the CondoGuard Deductible Credit
content:
Rating supplement of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy for the credit returned on a deductible raise.

**Rule.** The loss-history share of the deductible credit counts the claim payments issued on the CondoGuard policy fewer than 60 whole months before the day of the raise: it is 0.60 for two or more, 0.80 for exactly one, and 1.00 for none. The share is applied to the product of the annual premium in force and the deductible step credit, before the full-year deductible credit is rounded. Where that product carries more than one deductible credit share, the shares are first multiplied together and then applied once to the product; none of them acts on the result of another.

**Counting.** Every claim payment issued on this CondoGuard policy, of any coverage part, dated fewer than 60 whole months before the day of the raise, counts once; two payments on one claim count as two.

| Claim payments in the 60-month window | Loss-history share |
|---|---|
| two or more | 0.60 |
| exactly one | 0.80 |
| none | 1.00, the credit is not reduced for losses |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical histories)

- A single payment issued 59 whole months before the raise: exactly one, 0.80. The same payment issued 60 whole months before: not counted, 1.00.
- A unit property payment and a personal property payment on one claim last year: two payments, 0.60.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

An annual premium in force of 850.00 USD and a step credit of 0.10 make a product of 85.00 USD; with 0.80 as the only share on it, 85.00 multiplied by 0.80 is 68.00 USD for the full-year deductible credit.
